scheme_name: Bharati Scheme for Education - 1st Class to 5th Class
other_conditions: Student must belong to the Brahmin community
Student must be studying in Andhra Pradesh
Parents/guardians must reside in Andhra Pradesh
Student must be enrolled in the Praja Sadhikara Survey (PSS)
Student must not have availed any amount under any other government scheme for the same purpose
Students benefiting from Archaka Welfare Trust are also eligible
Priority is given to orphans, differently abled (physically handicapped) children and children of single parents
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹5,000 per student for classes 1 to 5.
